note: Applied LAST by build.py. status: 'patch' = stated in the official patch notes; 'unverified' = the notes are vague (no location/name given).

items.where: Near the Route 4 → Route 10 entrance; toggle on/off (1.4.0b fixed pickup)
items.text: Exp All is now obtainable near the Route 4 → Route 10 entrance and can be toggled on and off (1.4.0; pickup fixed in 1.4.0b; a double-KO crash with it on was fixed in 1.4.1).
You can now Fly to the Daycare and to the Route 4 → Route 10 entrance.
New working PCs include the Move Deleter house (location of that house is assumed to be the Venesi one — unverified) and the Epsilon rest house.
A bug with the healing lady on Route 8 was fixed.
The plot encounter on Route 14 can no longer be skipped.
Actan now respawns daily if you haven't caught it.
Mega Drilgann's ability is now correctly Sand Rush.
The Route 10 waterfall was adjusted to prevent a softlock.
The Buizel in the Hidden Grotto now has Soak.
Item prices were tweaked in 1.4.0c, so shop prices on the wiki may be out of date.
Encounter rates in the Dream Nuclear Plant were adjusted; this binder has no updated rates (unverified).
The map in your room now shows the language flag your caught Pokémon will have (useful for the Masuda Method).
